def filter_documents(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> List[Document]:  # noqa: ARG002
    if filters:
        filter_conditions = ' AND '.join([f"{key} = %s" for key in filters.keys()])
        sql_get_docs = SQL(f"SELECT * FROM {self.table_name} WHERE {filter_conditions}")
        result = self._execute_sql(sql_get_docs, params=tuple(filters.values()), error_msg="Could not filter documents from PgvectorDocumentStore", cursor=self._dict_cursor)
    else:
        sql_get_docs = SQL("SELECT * FROM {table_name}").format(table_name=Identifier(self.table_name))
        result = self._execute_sql(sql_get_docs, error_msg="Could not filter documents from PgvectorDocumentStore", cursor=self._dict_cursor)

    # Fetch all the records
    records = result.fetchall()
    docs = self._from_pg_to_haystack_documents(records)
    return docs
